fees.notes: AIMST does not publish tuition fees on its official website: programme pages list entry requirements/structure only and the International Students page lists programme durations and visa/accommodation costs but no tuition. Fees are provided on application/enquiry (choose@aimst.edu.my). Source: https://aimst.edu.my/international-students/ (checked 2026-09-18).

requirements.local: AIMST Foundation/Matriculation CGPA 2.0 + Add Math credit at SPM. OR STPM Grade C x2 + credit in Add Math OR Math + Science/Tech/Engineering at SPM. OR STPM Science Stream. OR Diploma in Computing CGPA 2.50. OR Science & Tech Diploma CGPA 2.75. OR DKM/DVM Computing CGPA 2.50. OR DLKM Computing CGPA 2.50.
